name: easier-life-skills
description: Reusable skill plugins for Claude Code — changelog generation, dead code detection, documentation, brainstorming, and more

plugins.name: brainstorm
plugins.description: Suggest the 5 most valuable next features or improvements for a project

plugins.name: changelog
plugins.description: Generate or update CHANGELOG.md from git history

plugins.name: cost-tracker
plugins.description: Append token usage and estimated cost to ~/.claude/cost-log.jsonl on every Stop event

plugins.name: cv-linkedin
plugins.description: Analyze and improve a CV and LinkedIn profile (driven by the official LinkedIn data export, not live scraping) with stronger language, quantified achievements, and aligned keywords

plugins.name: document-project
plugins.description: Create or improve project documentation with README and /docs structure

plugins.name: find-breaking-rest-api
plugins.description: Find breaking changes in REST APIs by analyzing git history

plugins.name: find-dead-code
plugins.description: Find unused functions, classes, variables, and imports across languages

plugins.name: find-skills
plugins.description: Analyze the active repository and recommend relevant Claude Code skills from known marketplaces

plugins.name: improve-logging
plugins.description: Audit logging quality and produce prioritized fix recommendations

plugins.name: scaffold
plugins.description: Generate a new plugin skeleton (plugin.json, SKILL.md, evals.json, optional agents/references) from a single prompt

plugins.name: site-audit
plugins.description: Audit a website for UX issues, bugs, accessibility problems, and unexpected behavior. site-mapper crawls once via Playwright MCP to produce sitemap.json; ux-analyst, accessibility-auditor, performance-auditor, and bug-script-runner then run in parallel against the shared artifact. bug-script-runner generates a Playwright spec on the fly using real selectors and executes it via npx playwright test.

plugins.name: task-agent
plugins.description: Read tasks from agent-tasks.yml, implement each via an agent, and open PRs
